title: Backend Developer
overview: A Backend Developer architects server-side logic, designs and implements RESTful APIs, manages database schemas, builds authentication systems, and develops scalable microservices. They work with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, Flask, Express.js, and Spring Boot to power modern web and mobile applications.
required_soft_skills: Collaboration with frontend and DevOps teams
career_roadmap: 1. Master Python and build REST APIs with FastAPI or Django REST Framework.
2. Learn SQL deeply: JOINs, indexing, migrations, query optimization.
3. Study data structures, algorithms, and system design fundamentals.
4. Build 3-5 portfolio projects: API servers, authentication services, CRUD apps.
5. Learn Docker, write Dockerfiles, and deploy containerized applications.
6. Contribute to open-source backend projects on GitHub.
7. Apply for Junior Backend Developer or API Developer roles.
